template: truncate(trade_when(greater(ts_rank(ts_regression(divide(winsorize(vector_neut(ts_backfill({fundreportedequityassets}, 63), ts_backfill({reported_asset_value}, 63)), std=4), add(ts_std_dev(returns, 21), 0.001)), group_mean(divide(winsorize(vector_neut(ts_backfill({fundreportedequityassets}, 63), ts_backfill({reported_asset_value}, 63)), std=4), add(ts_std_dev(returns, 21), 0.001)), log(ts_backfill({reported_asset_value}, 63)), industry), 252, rettype=0), 126), 0.85), ts_target_tvr_decay(ts_regression(divide(winsorize(vector_neut(ts_backfill({fundreportedequityassets}, 63), ts_backfill({reported_asset_value}, 63)), std=4), add(ts_std_dev(returns, 21), 0.001)), group_mean(divide(winsorize(vector_neut(ts_backfill({fundreportedequityassets}, 63), ts_backfill({reported_asset_value}, 63)), std=4), add(ts_std_dev(returns, 21), 0.001)), log(ts_backfill({reported_asset_value}, 63)), industry), 252, rettype=0), 0.5), 0), maxPercent=0.015)
idea: 基于CAPM残差思想，将风险调整后配置强度对行业市值加权组合进行252日时间序列回归（ts_regression），剥离系统性配置趋势以提取纯特质性择时能力（回归残差）；结合目标换手率约束（ts_target_tvr_decay）降低实施成本，并仅当残差处于历史极端分位（ts_rank>0.85）时开仓，配合截断控制（truncate）管理集中度风险。
